newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Companion companies complete loans.
newsitem.headline: HK's Companion companies complete loans.

text.p: A HK$250 million term loan/revolving credit facility for Companion Building Material (Holdings) Ltd and Companion Marble Ltd has been completed, arranger Standard Chartered Bank said on Tuesday.

A HK$100 million facility for Companion Building Material (Holdings) was divided into a HK$40 million revolving credit and a HK$60 million term loan. The deal was guaranteed by the issuer's subsidiary Ellca Co Ltd.

A HK$150 million facility for Companion Marble Ltd was divided into a HK$60 million revolving credit and a HK$90 million term loan. The deal was guaranteed by Companion Marble's parent, Companion Marble (Holdings) Ltd.
Both facilities have a maturity of three years and pay a coupon of 145 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Five international banks in addition to the arranger joined the syndication.
They are Fuji Bank, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank, Bayerische Vereinsbank, Daiwa Bank and Rabobank, which joined as co-arrangers.
